# Vendored copy

Source code mirrored from https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2 (branch `main`,
commit `4b2d053` era, tag `v1.2.0`) on 2026-08-24.

This directory contains the LTX-2 pipeline source only. Model checkpoints
(including the legacy LTX-2.3 checkpoints — see `MODELS-LTX-2.3.md`) are
multi-gigabyte files hosted on Hugging Face and are **not** included here;
download them separately per the instructions in `README.md` /
`MODELS-LTX-2.3.md`.
